title: AI & Machine Learning
tagline: Intelligent solutions that transform your data into advantage
description: Leverage the power of artificial intelligence and machine learning to automate processes, gain insights, and create intelligent products. Our team specializes in NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, and LLM integration.

subServices.title: Agent Workflow
subServices.tagline: Orchestrated multi-agent pipelines for complex task automation
subServices.description: We design and deploy intelligent agent workflows that coordinate multiple AI agents to execute complex, multi-step business processes. From data collection and analysis to decision-making and execution, our agent workflows operate autonomously with human-in-the-loop oversight.
keyPoints: Multi-agent orchestration with dynamic task routing and dependency management
Human-in-the-loop approval gates for critical decision points
Observability dashboard with real-time agent trace logs and performance metrics
Pluggable tool ecosystem — integrate APIs, databases, and external services seamlessly
Self-healing workflows with automatic retry, fallback, and escalation policies

subServices.title: Agentic System
subServices.tagline: Autonomous AI systems that perceive, reason, and act
subServices.description: We build agentic AI systems that operate autonomously within your domain — perceiving environment changes, reasoning about optimal actions, and executing tasks without constant human intervention. Goal-oriented, self-correcting, and continuously learning.
keyPoints: Goal-oriented task decomposition with recursive sub-goal planning
Memory-augmented agents with long-term and episodic recall
Closed-loop feedback systems with reinforcement learning from outcomes
Safety-constrained action spaces with guardrails and boundary enforcement
Continuous model fine-tuning based on real-world performance data

subServices.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
subServices.tagline: Embedded AI engineering on-site to ship production-ready solutions
subServices.description: Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with your team to rapidly architect, build, and deploy AI solutions in your environment. We bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and your production systems — delivering working software in weeks, not quarters.
keyPoints: Rapid on-site deployment with deep integration into your existing infrastructure
Custom AI solution design tailored to your proprietary data and domain
End-to-end ownership from requirements gathering to production monitoring
Knowledge transfer and team upskilling through paired engineering sessions
Iterative delivery with two-week sprint cycles and continuous stakeholder demos

subServices.title: Specific Business Agent
subServices.tagline: Purpose-built AI agents trained on your business domain
subServices.description: We develop specialized AI agents fine-tuned for specific business functions — sales, customer support, compliance, HR, procurement, and more. Each agent is trained on your data, understands your domain language, and integrates with your existing tools and workflows.
keyPoints: Domain-specific RAG pipelines with your proprietary knowledge base
Fine-tuned LLMs on industry terminology, policies, and historical interactions
Seamless CRM, ERP, and ticketing system integration via native connectors
Automated SLA monitoring with escalation triggers and performance dashboards
Role-based agent personas with tailored communication styles and access controls

subServices.title: AI Integrated Systems
subServices.tagline: End-to-end AI infusion into your existing product ecosystem
subServices.description: We retrofit your existing software products with AI capabilities — adding intelligence to search, recommendations, document processing, decision support, and more. No rebuild required. We integrate AI as a seamless layer within your current architecture.
keyPoints: Plug-and-play AI middleware layer that sits on top of your existing stack
Batch and real-time inference pipelines with latency SLA guarantees
A/B testing framework for measuring AI feature impact on business KPIs
Gradual rollout with feature flags, canary deployments, and rollback support
Comprehensive monitoring with drift detection, model decay alerts, and retraining triggers

title: Web Development
tagline: Full-stack web applications built for scale
description: We build modern, performant web applications using cutting-edge technologies. From responsive frontends with React and Next.js to robust backends with Node.js, Python, and Go, our team delivers end-to-end solutions that drive business growth.

subServices.title: Custom Web Application
subServices.tagline: Tailored solutions engineered for your exact business needs
subServices.description: We design and build bespoke web applications from the ground up, tailored to your unique workflows, business logic, and growth goals. No templates, no compromises — just purpose-built software that gives you a competitive edge.
keyPoints: End-to-end custom development from concept to deployment
Scalable microservices architecture that grows with your user base
Seamless third-party integrations with your existing toolchain
Agile delivery with iterative releases and continuous feedback
Enterprise-grade security with SSO, RBAC, and data encryption

subServices.title: E-Commerce Web
subServices.tagline: High-converting online stores engineered for revenue growth
subServices.description: We build feature-rich e-commerce platforms that drive sales and delight customers. From product discovery to checkout, every interaction is optimized for conversion, speed, and mobile-first shopping experiences.
keyPoints: Smart product search with faceted filtering and AI recommendations
One-click checkout with 20+ payment gateway integrations
Real-time inventory management across multi-warehouse operations
Subscription & recurring billing engine with automated invoicing
Mobile-first PWA with 60+ Lighthouse score for performance

subServices.title: SaaS Web
subServices.tagline: Multi-tenant platforms built for rapid subscription growth
subServices.description: We architect and build SaaS platforms that scale from your first 10 users to your first million. Multi-tenant isolation, usage-based billing, and self-service onboarding are built in from day one.
keyPoints: Multi-tenant architecture with strict data isolation per tenant
Usage-based & tiered subscription management with proration
Self-service onboarding with Stripe Connect and SSO
Real-time analytics dashboard with custom reporting engine
API-first design with versioned REST & GraphQL endpoints

subServices.title: Dashboard Web Application
subServices.tagline: Data-rich command centers that turn raw data into decisions
subServices.description: We build sophisticated dashboard applications that visualize complex data in real time. Interactive charts, drill-down analytics, and customizable widgets put actionable insights at your team's fingertips.
keyPoints: Real-time data streaming with WebSocket and Server-Sent Events
Interactive D3.js and Chart.js visualizations with drill-down capability
Role-based access control with per-widget permission granularity
Custom report builder with export to PDF, CSV, and Excel
Drag-and-drop widget layout with user-configurable dashboards

subServices.title: Business Web
subServices.tagline: Corporate websites that establish authority and generate leads
subServices.description: We craft high-impact corporate websites that communicate your brand story, showcase your expertise, and convert visitors into qualified leads. Modern design, blazing-fast performance, and SEO-optimized out of the box.
keyPoints: Strategic information architecture with data-driven UX design
Built-in lead capture with CRM integration (HubSpot, Salesforce)
Headless CMS with structured content for omnichannel delivery
Enterprise SEO with structured data, sitemaps, and Core Web Vitals
Global CDN delivery with sub-second load times worldwide

title: Cloud Consulting
tagline: Strategic cloud solutions for modern infrastructure
description: Navigate the cloud landscape with confidence. We provide end-to-end cloud consulting — from migration strategy and architecture design to implementation and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

subServices.title: Architecture Designer
subServices.tagline: Scalable, resilient cloud architectures engineered for your workload
subServices.description: We design cloud-native architectures that balance performance, cost, security, and scalability. From greenfield designs to legacy modernization, our architects deliver battle-tested blueprints following AWS Well-Architected, Azure CAF, and GCP AGF frameworks.
keyPoints: Well-Architected Framework reviews with actionable remediation roadmaps
Multi-cloud and hybrid architecture designs with unified governance
Cost modeling and total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis across providers
Disaster recovery and business continuity architecture with RTO/RPO SLAs
Security-by-design with zero-trust networking, encryption, and compliance controls

subServices.title: Cloud Deployment
subServices.tagline: Automated, repeatable deployments from development to production
subServices.description: We automate your entire cloud deployment pipeline — infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, configuration management, and monitoring. GitOps-driven, fully auditable, and designed for zero-downtime releases across all environments.
keyPoints: GitOps-driven infrastructure with ArgoCD, Flux, and automated syncing
Immutable deployments with blue-green, canary, and rolling update strategies
Infrastructure as Code pipelines with Terraform, Terragrunt, and Crossplane
Automated secret management with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or Azure Key Vault
Observability stack with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and centralized logging
